# Set Up

The first thing we need to do is load the packages we will be using for this analysis.
If you need to install any of them, un-comment the relevant lines below:

```{r}
# Install Packages
# install.packages("nflfastR")     # NFL play-by-play data
# install.packages("ggplot2")      # Plotting
# install.packages("ggimage")      # Team logo images on plots
# install.packages("ggrepel")      # Non-overlapping text labels
# install.packages("dplyr")        # Data manipulation
```

```{r}
# Load Packages
library(nflfastR)   # NFL play-by-play data
library(ggplot2)    # Plotting
library(ggimage)    # Team logo images
library(ggrepel)    # Non-overlapping labels
library(dplyr)      # Data manipulation
```

We will define a custom theme and color palette here once so every plot is consistent:

```{r}
# Custom plot theme
theme_nfl <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray45"),
    axis.title         = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text          = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.title       = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text        = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10)
  )

# Season config
current_season     <- 2026
historical_seasons <- (current_season - 4):current_season   # 2022–2026

# League-wide run/pass colors
col_run  <- "#2471a3"   # Blue  — run
col_pass <- "#c0392b"   # Red   — pass

# Raiders team colors
col_run_lv  <- "#a5acaf"  # Silver — run
col_pass_lv <- "#1a1a1a"  # Black  — pass

# Season range label
season_label <- paste0(current_season, " Season  |  ",
                       min(historical_seasons), "–", max(historical_seasons),
                       " avg in parentheses")
```

## Generating the Data File

Run the chunk below **once** to download raw play-by-play data, compute drive context columns, and save a slim `.rda` file. After it runs you can comment it out and just load the file in the next chunk.

```{r}
# ── Data Generation (run once, then comment out) ──────────────────────────────
library(nflfastR)
library(dplyr)

raw_pbp <- as.data.frame(load_pbp(seasons = historical_seasons))

# Step 1: Summarise each drive — determine granular outcome from play-level columns
drive_meta <- raw_pbp %>%
  filter(season_type %in% c("REG", "POST"), !is.na(posteam)) %>%
  group_by(game_id, drive) %>%
  summarise(
    posteam    = first(posteam),
    defteam    = first(defteam),
    is_pass_td = any(pass_touchdown == 1,                          na.rm = TRUE),
    is_rush_td = any(rush_touchdown  == 1,                         na.rm = TRUE),
    is_fg_made = any(field_goal_result == "made",                  na.rm = TRUE),
    is_fg_miss = any(field_goal_result %in% c("missed","blocked"), na.rm = TRUE),
    is_punt    = any(play_type == "punt",                          na.rm = TRUE),
    is_int     = any(interception == 1,                            na.rm = TRUE),
    is_fumble  = any(fumble_lost == 1,                             na.rm = TRUE),
    is_downs   = any(fourth_down_failed == 1,                      na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(drive_outcome = case_when(
    is_pass_td ~ "Passing TD",
    is_rush_td ~ "Rushing TD",
    is_fg_made ~ "FG Made",
    is_fg_miss ~ "FG Missed",
    is_punt    ~ "Punt",
    is_int     ~ "Interception",
    is_fumble  ~ "Fumble",
    is_downs   ~ "Turnover on Downs",
    TRUE       ~ "Other"
  ))

# Step 2a: Offensive context — what did this offense's own previous drive end with?
prev_off_drive <- drive_meta %>%
  arrange(game_id, drive) %>%
  group_by(game_id, posteam) %>%
  mutate(prev_own_drive_result = lag(drive_outcome)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(game_id, drive, prev_own_drive_result)

# Step 2b: Defensive context — what did the previous opponent do against this defteam?
#           (i.e., how did Team B's last defensive series end?)
prev_def_drive <- drive_meta %>%
  arrange(game_id, drive) %>%
  group_by(game_id, defteam) %>%
  mutate(prev_def_drive_result = lag(drive_outcome)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(game_id, drive, prev_def_drive_result)

# Step 3a: Compute after_timeout flag
# Flags the very next run/pass play after a timeout that was called during that
# team's own possession (either team called it while they had the ball).
# Also flags each team's first run/pass play of Q2 and Q4 (end-of-Q1/Q3 break).

# Slim run/pass play index used for joining
rp_index <- raw_pbp %>%
  filter(play_type %in% c("run", "pass"), !is.na(yards_gained),
         season_type %in% c("REG", "POST"), !is.na(posteam)) %>%
  select(game_id, play_id, posteam, qtr)

# All timeout events with the possession team at the time
timeout_events <- raw_pbp %>%
  filter(season_type %in% c("REG", "POST"), !is.na(posteam),
         coalesce(timeout, 0) == 1) %>%
  select(game_id, timeout_play_id = play_id, posteam)

# For each timeout, find the very next run/pass play for the SAME possession team
timeout_next <- timeout_events %>%
  inner_join(rp_index %>% select(game_id, play_id, posteam),
             by = c("game_id", "posteam")) %>%
  filter(play_id > timeout_play_id) %>%
  group_by(game_id, timeout_play_id) %>%
  slice_min(play_id, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(game_id, play_id) %>%
  mutate(after_timeout = TRUE)

# Each team's first run/pass play of Q2 or Q4 (end-of-Q1 / end-of-Q3 break)
qtr_break_next <- rp_index %>%
  arrange(game_id, play_id) %>%
  group_by(game_id, posteam) %>%
  mutate(prev_qtr = lag(qtr, default = -1L)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter((qtr == 2L & prev_qtr == 1L) | (qtr == 4L & prev_qtr == 3L)) %>%
  distinct(game_id, play_id) %>%
  mutate(after_timeout = TRUE)

timeout_flags <- bind_rows(timeout_next, qtr_break_next) %>%
  distinct(game_id, play_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Step 3b: Filter to run/pass plays, tag first play of each drive, join all contexts
pbp_nfl <- raw_pbp %>%
  filter(
    play_type   %in% c("run", "pass"),
    season_type %in% c("REG", "POST"),
    !is.na(yards_gained),
    !is.na(posteam)
  ) %>%
  arrange(game_id, play_id) %>%
  group_by(game_id, drive) %>%
  mutate(first_drive_play = row_number() == 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(prev_off_drive,  by = c("game_id", "drive")) %>%
  left_join(prev_def_drive,  by = c("game_id", "drive")) %>%
  left_join(timeout_flags,   by = c("game_id", "play_id")) %>%
  mutate(after_timeout = coalesce(after_timeout, FALSE)) %>%
  select(
    play_type, posteam, defteam, down, ydstogo,
    yardline_100, score_differential, qtr, season,
    quarter_seconds_remaining,
    first_drive_play, after_timeout, prev_own_drive_result, prev_def_drive_result
  )

save(pbp_nfl, file = "C:/Users/c.travasos/Downloads/SBx/nfl_pbp.rda")
message("Saved nfl_pbp.rda — ", nrow(pbp_nfl), " plays")
```

# Data Exploration

Before diving into analysis, let's explore the dataset to understand what we are working with.

View the first few rows:

```{r}
head(pbp_nfl)
```

View the last few rows:

```{r}
tail(pbp_nfl)
```

Check the dimensions of the dataset:

```{r}
dim(pbp_nfl)
```

View a summary of all columns:

```{r}
summary(pbp_nfl)
```

For this analysis the key columns we will be working with are:

* `play_type` - Type of play (`run` or `pass`)
* `posteam` - The team with possession (offense)
* `defteam` - The defending team
* `down` - The down (1, 2, 3, or 4)
* `ydstogo` - Yards needed for a first down
* `yardline_100` - Yards from the opposing end zone (100 = own goal line, 1 = opponent goal line)
* `score_differential` - Score difference at the time of the play (positive = leading)
* `qtr` - Quarter of the game
* `season` - The NFL season year
* `first_drive_play` - TRUE if this is the first play of the drive
* `after_timeout` - TRUE if a timeout (or end-of-Q1/Q3 break) occurred since the previous run/pass play
* `prev_own_drive_result` - How the possession team's previous own drive ended (e.g. "Passing TD", "Punt", "Interception")

Let's filter the data down to just run and pass plays, removing special teams, penalties, and other play types:

```{r}
# pbp_nfl is already filtered to run/pass plays with NAs removed by the
# generation script — assign directly
rp_plays <- pbp_nfl
```

We will also pre-build all the situational bins here so they are available throughout the analysis:

```{r}
rp_plays <- rp_plays %>%
  mutate(
    # Distance bins
    distance_bin = case_when(
      ydstogo <= 3   ~ "Short (1-3)",
      ydstogo <= 7   ~ "Medium (4-7)",
      ydstogo <= 10  ~ "Standard (8-10)",
      ydstogo > 10   ~ "Long (10+)"
    ),
    distance_bin = factor(distance_bin,
                          levels = c("Short (1-3)", "Medium (4-7)",
                                     "Standard (8-10)", "Long (10+)")),
    # Field position zones (numbers = yards from own end zone)
    field_zone = case_when(
      yardline_100 >= 80 ~ "Own Territory (0-20)",
      yardline_100 >= 51 ~ "Own Half (21-50)",
      yardline_100 >= 21 ~ "Opponent Half (51-79)",
      yardline_100 <= 20 ~ "Red Zone (1-20)"
    ),
    field_zone = factor(field_zone,
                        levels = c("Own Territory (0-20)", "Own Half (21-50)",
                                   "Opponent Half (51-79)", "Red Zone (1-20)")),
    # Score differential bins
    score_bin = case_when(
      score_differential <= -21 ~ "Down 21+",
      score_differential <= -14 ~ "Down 14-20",
      score_differential <= -7  ~ "Down 7-13",
      score_differential <= -1  ~ "Down 1-6",
      score_differential == 0   ~ "Tied",
      score_differential <= 6   ~ "Up 1-6",
      score_differential <= 13  ~ "Up 7-13",
      score_differential <= 20  ~ "Up 14-20",
      score_differential >= 21  ~ "Up 21+"
    ),
    score_bin = factor(score_bin,
                       levels = c("Down 21+", "Down 14-20", "Down 7-13", "Down 1-6",
                                  "Tied", "Up 1-6", "Up 7-13", "Up 14-20", "Up 21+"))
  )
```

```{r}
# Drive context bins — requires prev_own_drive_result column (from generation script)
drive_ctx_levels <- c("Passing TD", "Rushing TD", "FG Made", "FG Missed",
                      "Punt", "Interception", "Fumble", "Turnover on Downs", "Other")

if (all(c("prev_own_drive_result", "prev_def_drive_result") %in% names(rp_plays))) {
  rp_plays <- rp_plays %>%
    mutate(
      drive_context     = factor(prev_own_drive_result, levels = drive_ctx_levels),
      drive_context_def = factor(prev_def_drive_result, levels = drive_ctx_levels)
    )
} else {
  rp_plays <- rp_plays %>%
    mutate(drive_context = NA_character_, drive_context_def = NA_character_, first_drive_play = FALSE)
  message("Drive context columns not found — regenerate nfl_pbp.rda to enable drive analysis.")
}
```

Check how many plays we are working with:

```{r}
dim(rp_plays)
```

# League-Wide Run/Pass Tendencies

Before looking at individual teams, let's understand the league-wide tendencies across all three seasons.

## Overall Run/Pass Split

```{r}
# Calculate overall run/pass split
overall_split <- rp_plays %>%
  group_by(play_type) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))

overall_split
```

```{r}
ggplot(overall_split, aes(x = play_type, y = pct, fill = play_type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.45) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct, "%")),
            vjust = -0.4, fontface = "bold", size = 4.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("run" = col_run, "pass" = col_pass)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 70), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_nfl +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = "Play Type",
       y = "Percentage of Plays (%)",
       title = "NFL League-Wide Run/Pass Split",
       subtitle = season_label)
```

## Run/Pass Split by Down

```{r}
# Calculate run/pass split by down
split_by_down <- rp_plays %>%
  filter(down %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4)) %>%
  group_by(down, play_type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(down) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))

split_by_down
```

```{r}
ggplot(split_by_down, aes(x = factor(down), y = pct, fill = play_type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct, "%")),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("run" = col_run, "pass" = col_pass)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 85), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_nfl +
  labs(x = "Down",
       y = "Percentage of Plays (%)",
       title = "NFL Run/Pass Split by Down",
       subtitle = season_label,
       fill = "Play Type")
```


# Team-Level Tendencies

Now let's zoom in on individual team tendencies. Which teams run the most? Which teams pass the most?

## Run/Pass Rate by Team

```{r}
# Calculate run/pass counts and rates per team
team_split <- rp_plays %>%
  group_by(posteam, play_type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(posteam) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n),
         pct   = round(n / total * 100, 1)) %>%
  filter(play_type == "pass") %>%
  rename(pass_rate = pct, pass_n = n) %>%
  mutate(rush_rate = 100 - pass_rate)

# Join team colors and logos
team_split <- team_split %>%
  left_join(team_info %>% select(team_abbr, team_color, team_logo_espn),
            by = c("posteam" = "team_abbr"))
```

```{r fig.height=9}
ggplot(team_split, aes(x = reorder(posteam, pass_rate), y = pass_rate)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = team_color), width = 0.7) +
  geom_image(aes(image = team_logo_espn), size = 0.03, asp = 16/9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(team_split$pass_rate),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = mean(team_split$pass_rate) + 1.2,
           label = paste0("League Avg: ", round(mean(team_split$pass_rate), 1), "%"),
           size = 3, color = "gray30", hjust = 0) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 80), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_nfl +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray90"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Pass Rate (%)",
       title = "NFL Pass Rate by Team",
       subtitle = season_label)
```

# Situational Decision-Making

Now let's look at how run/pass decisions shift based on game situation.

## Effect of Score Differential on Play Calling

```{r}
# League pass rate by score bin
pass_by_score <- rp_plays %>%
  filter(!is.na(score_bin)) %>%
  group_by(score_bin, play_type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(score_bin) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
  filter(play_type == "pass")
```

```{r}
ggplot(pass_by_score, aes(x = score_bin, y = pct, group = 1)) +
  geom_area(fill = col_pass, alpha = 0.12) +
  geom_line(color = col_pass, linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = col_pass, size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct, "%")),
            vjust = -0.8, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", color = col_pass) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(30, 85), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_nfl +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 12, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Score Differential",
       y = "Pass Rate (%)",
       title = "NFL Pass Rate by Score Differential",
       subtitle = season_label)
```

## Effect of Quarter on Play Calling

```{r}
# League pass rate by quarter
pass_by_qtr <- rp_plays %>%
  filter(qtr %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4)) %>%
  group_by(qtr, play_type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(qtr) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
  filter(play_type == "pass")
```

```{r}
ggplot(pass_by_qtr, aes(x = factor(qtr), y = pct, group = 1)) +
  geom_area(fill = col_pass, alpha = 0.12) +
  geom_line(color = col_pass, linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = col_pass, size = 3.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct, "%")),
            vjust = -0.8, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", color = col_pass) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(30, 75), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_nfl +
  labs(x = "Quarter",
       y = "Pass Rate (%)",
       title = "NFL Pass Rate by Quarter",
       subtitle = season_label)
```

# Las Vegas Raiders — Offensive Breakdown

We will now filter down to only Raiders offensive plays and apply the same breakdowns, with a dashed line showing the league average for each situation as a reference point.

```{r}
# Filter to Raiders offensive plays only
raiders <- rp_plays %>%
  filter(posteam == "LV")

dim(raiders)
```

```{r}
# Pre-compute league averages for reference lines
lg_pass_rate       <- mean(rp_plays$play_type == "pass") * 100
lg_pass_by_down    <- rp_plays %>%
  filter(down %in% c(1,2,3,4)) %>%
  group_by(down) %>%
  summarise(lg_pct = round(mean(play_type == "pass") * 100, 1))
lg_pass_by_dist    <- rp_plays %>%
  group_by(distance_bin) %>%
  summarise(lg_pct = round(mean(play_type == "pass") * 100, 1))
lg_pass_by_zone    <- rp_plays %>%
  filter(!is.na(field_zone)) %>%
  group_by(field_zone) %>%
  summarise(lg_pct = round(mean(play_type == "pass") * 100, 1))
```

```{r}
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 90), expand = c(0, 0)) +
```

# Las Vegas Raiders — Defensive Breakdown

Now let's look at the inverse: how do opposing offenses attack the Raiders? We filter to all plays where the Raiders are the defense and apply the same breakdowns.

Note: `score_differential` is always from the offensive team's perspective, so we negate it here so the score bins reflect the Raiders' game situation.

```{r}
# Filter to plays where Raiders are on defense
raiders_def <- rp_plays %>%
  filter(defteam == "LV") %>%
  mutate(raiders_score_bin = case_when(
    -score_differential <= -21 ~ "Down 21+",
    -score_differential <= -14 ~ "Down 14-20",
    -score_differential <= -7  ~ "Down 7-13",
    -score_differential <= -1  ~ "Down 1-6",
    -score_differential == 0   ~ "Tied",
    -score_differential <= 6   ~ "Up 1-6",
    -score_differential <= 13  ~ "Up 7-13",
    -score_differential <= 20  ~ "Up 14-20",
    -score_differential >= 21  ~ "Up 21+"
  ),
  raiders_score_bin = factor(raiders_score_bin,
                             levels = c("Down 21+", "Down 14-20", "Down 7-13", "Down 1-6",
                                        "Tied", "Up 1-6", "Up 7-13", "Up 14-20", "Up 21+")))

dim(raiders_def)
```

# Custom Situation Filter

Use this section to query any combination of down, distance, score differential, and quarter.
Set any filter to `NULL` to include all values for that dimension.

Valid options for each filter:
* `sel_down` — `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, or `NULL`
* `sel_distance` — `"Short (1-3)"`, `"Medium (4-7)"`, `"Standard (8-10)"`, `"Long (10+)"`, or `NULL`
* `sel_field` — `"Own Territory (0-20)"`, `"Own Half (21-50)"`, `"Opponent Half (51-79)"`, `"Red Zone (1-20)"`, or `NULL`
* `sel_score` — `"Down 21+"`, `"Down 14-20"`, `"Down 7-13"`, `"Down 1-6"`, `"Tied"`, `"Up 1-6"`, `"Up 7-13"`, `"Up 14-20"`, `"Up 21+"`, or `NULL`
* `sel_qtr` — `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5` (OT), or `NULL`

```{r}
# --- Set your filters here ---
sel_down     <- 2                        # e.g. 2
sel_distance <- "Short (1-3)"            # e.g. "Short (1-3)"
sel_field    <- "Opponent Half (51-79)"  # e.g. "Opponent Half (51-79)"
sel_score    <- "Down 7-13"              # e.g. "Down 7-13"  (from Raiders' perspective)
sel_qtr      <- 3                        # e.g. 3 — use 5 for OT
# -----------------------------
```

```{r}
# Helper function to apply filters
apply_situation_filter <- function(df, score_col = "score_bin") {
  if (!is.null(sel_down))     df <- df %>% filter(down == sel_down)
  if (!is.null(sel_distance)) df <- df %>% filter(distance_bin == sel_distance)
  if (!is.null(sel_field))    df <- df %>% filter(field_zone == sel_field)
  if (!is.null(sel_score))    df <- df %>% filter(.data[[score_col]] == sel_score)
  if (!is.null(sel_qtr))      df <- df %>% filter(qtr == sel_qtr)
  df
}

# Auto-generate subtitle label from active filters
situation_label <- paste(
  c(if (!is.null(sel_down))     paste("Down:", sel_down),
    if (!is.null(sel_distance)) paste("Distance:", sel_distance),
    if (!is.null(sel_field))    paste("Field:", sel_field),
    if (!is.null(sel_score))    paste("Score:", sel_score),
    if (!is.null(sel_qtr))      paste("Quarter:", sel_qtr)),
  collapse = " | "
)
```

## Offense — Raiders Run/Pass Split for Selected Situation

```{r}
raiders_situation <- apply_situation_filter(raiders, score_col = "score_bin")

raiders_sit_split <- raiders_situation %>%
  group_by(play_type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))
```

```{r}
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct, "%\n(n=", n, ")")),
            vjust = -0.3, fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("run" = col_run_lv, "pass" = col_pass_lv)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 80), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_nfl +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = "Play Type",
       y = "Percentage of Plays (%)",
       title = "Las Vegas Raiders — Offense Run/Pass Split",
       subtitle = situation_label)
```
